messages:
anya: Quick intake — customer Gamma wants a hard launch checklist + rollback guardrails for tenant-scoped model rollouts. They specifically care about predictable latency and no customer-visible quality regressions.
anya: Problem statement: when we flip tenants to a quantized model variant, some prompts degrade. They want a defined acceptance gate so they can enable rollouts safely.
anya: Proposed goals: short list — (1) acceptance criteria (latency & eval-based quality thresholds), (2) rollout playbook (canary %, automatic rollback conditions), (3) per-tenant observability on cost/latency/quality, (4) docs & runbook for on-call.
anya: Non-goals: global autoscaling policy, deep retraining; keep v1 focused on serving-side checks + metrics.
carlos: agree on scope. for acceptance criteria we should specify both metric types and evaluation cadence. suggestion: p95 latency, token-level error rate on prompt set, and synthetic fuzz tests every deploy.
mike: +1. also add SLA for canary duration and max QPS for canary. we should avoid long canaries ( >24h ) for customers wanting fast rollouts.
sophia: for UX, we need a clear toggle and a visual timeline in Console: canary, ramp, stable, rollback. show most recent eval diff and the top 5 failing prompts.
ben: ops question — where do we store tenant-specific prompt sets? should be in their S3 or a managed eval bundle? If managed, we need retention & export.
carlos: recommend managed eval bundles for now (simpler onboarding). expose an API to upload a prompt list and label ground-truth. we can add S3 integration later.
anya: draft acceptance criteria (rough):
```
- p95 latency <= 250ms (end-to-end) during canary
- relative quality regression <= 2% on customer eval set (accuracy/score defined per-eval)
- no more than 0.5% increase in hallucination rate as measured by eval ruleset
- canary should run for at least 30 minutes and at most 24 hours unless manually extended
- automatic rollback triggers if any of the above violated for >3 consecutive sampling windows
```
mike: Need to define sampling window and how we compute "consecutive". propose 5-minute windows, require 3 windows = 15 minutes breach before rollback.
carlos: technical note — for hallucination detection we need a fast ruleset (regex + embedding similarity). design tradeoff: speed vs precision. suggest start with lightweight rules.
sophia: Edge case: tenant uploads very small eval set (e.g., 5 prompts). We should have a minimum eval size or degrade confidence -> require manual approval.
anya: Good call. Add minimum eval size = 20 prompts or fallback to product-wide benchmark with lower confidence.
ben: Rollout sequencing: canary 5% traffic for 30m -> 25% for 2h -> 100% (or manual stop). include a 'kill-switch' to instantly reassign traffic.
mike: Can we implement automated fallback to hosted-compatible model when rollback happens? That reduces customer downtime.
carlos: Yes, that's feasible: route to a pinned hosted model variant. need to confirm compat of tokenization & model outputs.
anya: Success metrics for the project:
- Reduction in customer-reported regressions during rollouts by 90%
- Time-to-recover from bad rollout < 10 minutes (measured from detection to traffic re-route)
- 80% of target customers can self-serve rollouts within 2 days of onboarding docs

anya: Acceptance checklist for PRD draft:
- [ ] define acceptance metric computation (owner: eng-data)
- [ ] implement canary traffic controller + kill switch (owner: eng-runtime)
- [ ] Console UX for rollout timeline & eval diffs (owner: design + frontend)
- [ ] eval upload API + storage (owner: prod-ops)
- [ ] runbook + SLOs for rollback (owner: SRE)

sophia: I'll prototype the Console screens this week, posting mocks by EOD Wed.
carlos: I'll scope the runtime work and post a tech spec by Friday.
ben: I'll reach out to Gamma to confirm minimum eval set and get sample prompts.
mike: tagging deploy bot to reserve a staging slot for an end-to-end test: @deploy-bot schedule staging-window 2024-11-08T14:00Z 2h
deploy-bot: scheduled staging window: 2024-11-08T14:00Z (2h). reminder will post 30m before. :white_check_mark:
anya: Next sync: quick triage on Friday 10am. objective: finalize PRD acceptance criteria and owners.
anya: any objections to finishing PRD this sprint?
carlos: no objections.
sophia: fine by me.
ben: good.
mike: ok.
anya: thanks all — I'll circulate the PRD draft in #product when it's ready.
